missionStatement: The San Luis Obispo High School Athletics Hall of Fame seeks to fulfill an enduring legacy of honoring excellence among our athletic alumni, coaches, and contributors — recognizing those whose accomplishments on and off the field embody the Tiger spirit.

athlete: Nominee must have graduated at least ten years prior to the year of induction.
Nominee must have participated in sports at SLOHS for more than one year.
Accomplishments at SLOHS and beyond must align with the Hall of Fame mission.
A complete nomination form must be submitted on the SLOHS HOF website.
coach: Coach nominee must have coached at SLOHS for a minimum of ten years (not necessarily consecutive).
Accomplishments at SLOHS and beyond must align with the Hall of Fame mission.

fund.title: The night ends. What they take home doesn't.
fund.lead: The Hall of Fame inducts a new class every other year. The award that goes into an inductee's hands outlives the evening by fifty years — it sits on a mantel, in an office, in a case their grandchildren walk past.
body: The Hall of Fame runs on volunteer time and a shoulder-tap budget. This fund is the standing account behind it: the engraved awards, the medallions worn when a name is read, the nameplates on the wall in the Big Gym, and the printed program that puts a career on the record. A class goes in every other year, so what comes in between inductions is exactly what makes the next one right.

It is also how alumni stay in it. You don't have to live in San Luis Obispo, or have a kid on a roster, to keep a Tiger's name on that wall. For former Tigers, this is a standing way to stay part of the program that shaped you.
fund.splitNote: This is the one SLOTAB gift that isn't split 75/25 between a team and the general fund. All of it goes to honoring inductees.
fund.goalLabel: for the Hall of Fame Fund

levels.blurb: Puts one inductee's name on the Hall of Fame wall, where every team that walks through the Big Gym reads it.
The medallion an inductee wears the moment their name is called at the Bash — and the one photo their family keeps.
The engraved keepsake that goes home with them and stays out on a shelf for the next fifty years.
Award, medallion, nameplate, and their place in the printed program — one Tiger's entire night covered by you.
Two inductees honored end to end, plus the program every guest in the room takes home.
Carries a full class of inductees and seeds the engraving for the class after it. Recognized from the stage.

fund.levelsNote: Levels are how the committee plans to spend the fund. Any amount helps — every Hall of Fame gift goes to honoring inductees, the next class and the ones after it, whatever the size.

gallery.caption: The Big Gym. Every banner up there started with somebody who's now eligible.
Ten years from now, one of these Tigers is a nominee.
Forty-six inductees so far. The list is nowhere near finished.

alumniCallout.title: Tiger alumni: this one is yours.
alumniCallout.body: The Hall of Fame is the part of SLOTAB that belongs to everyone who came through SLOHS, not only to the families here now. Give once, give ahead of each induction, or come to the Bash and see the class read out — the invitation is open.

fund.tributeHint: Giving for a coach, a teammate, or an inductee? Add their name at checkout and we'll list the gift in their honor in the ceremony program.
fund._note: Added 2026-08-21 for the Hall of Fame push (decision #184). REFRAMED 2026-08-24 on the Athletic Director's review (#186): a STANDING fund for the Hall of Fame going forward, not a Class of 2026 drive, with alumni as the audience. UPDATED 2026-08-25 (#187): goal set to the AD's $10,000, and the cadence corrected — SLOHS inducts a class EVERY OTHER YEAR, not every year. That error was in five strings; do not reintroduce it. Note `ceremony.venueDetail` above still reads 'where this year's Hall of Fame class is officially inducted', true in 2026 and wrong at the 2027 Bash — edit it then. WEEKLY REFRESH (#188): the board committed to updating the thermometer weekly, so `raisedAsOf` is an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the band STOPS PUBLISHING the figure once it is older than `raisedStaleAfterDays` — the bar reverts to showing the goal alone rather than a frozen number. The Monday cron email to the Treasurer carries both values ready to paste. ZERO START (#190): the board had no current balance to publish, so on 2026-08-27 the thermometer was started at `raisedDollars: 0` with today's date — a published $0, not the goal-only fallback. It counts WEBSITE gifts to this designation from that date forward; any cheque or Bash-night gift the Treasurer books to 'Donation: Hall of Fame' has to be added here by hand or the bar will under-report. Refresh `raisedDollars` AND `raisedAsOf` together every week — leaving the date behind is what makes the figure stop publishing. BALANCE ENTERED 2026-08-27 (#207): the AD came back with $250, so the bar moved off the zero start — `raisedDollars: 250` against the same `raisedAsOf`, which the zero start had already stamped. TWO TRAPS, both hit the same day. (1) $10,000 is the GOAL, not a balance: an instruction to 'put the initial Donation fund at $10k' was briefly read as an opening figure, which would have rendered the bar at 100% and published GOAL MET for a fund holding $250. If an edit is about to set `raisedDollars` equal to `goalDollars`, stop and check which number is being described. (2) The zero start is decision #203, not #190 — the reference above and two comments in HofFund.tsx say #190, which is the Square webhook decision. The dollar-to-item mapping in `levels` remains the committee's working plan, NOT quoted engraver pricing.

alumniMembership.title: Become an Alumni Member
alumniMembership.blurb: Former SLOHS Tigers can now support the next generation of athletes through a dedicated Alumni Membership tier. Alumni Members receive recognition at the Booster Bash, an invitation to the Hall of Fame induction, and updates on every Tiger team all year long.
